annotation.justification: The clause 'Previously sent data MAY be sent if no new data can be sent.' provides a clear conditional statement. It allows for the sending of previously sent data only when new data cannot be sent, and it uses the normative keyword 'MAY', which grants implementation discretion without introducing ambiguity. There is no conflicting or missing constraint that would lead to multiple materially different interpretations.
